title: A form shows the preview of the focused option
body:
The Claude adapter gives an `AskUserQuestion` option a preview, such as a code sample, under `_meta` in the option's schema entry. coax does not draw it, so in a live test a question whose options were two function signatures showed only their labels.

## Proposal

When the cursor is on an option with a preview, the preview shows below that question's options in a dim bordered block, as fixed-width text. Only the focused option's preview shows.

## Open

- The key the adapter uses under the option's `_meta`. It is `OPTION_META_KEY` in the adapter's bundled JavaScript, which needs reading.
